criteria.requirement: Add babel.core.negotiate_locale_preferences(header, available, *, sep="_", aliases=LOCALE_ALIASES). Parse bounded comma-separated language ranges and optional q values 0..1 with at most three decimals. Select descending quality, stable header order; reuse pinned negotiate_locale matching/aliases for each nonwildcard candidate and return spelling from available. Explicit q=0 language/prefix exclusions must apply before wildcard selection; wildcard picks first nonexcluded available. Reject malformed parameters, quality, headers over 8192 characters or 100 ranges. Materialize available once and preserve the old negotiator.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
